messages.subject: Re: Is auto.arima() can be done using sparkR
parts:
SparkR does not support auto.arima out of the box, but I guess it can be implemented using SparkR if you are aware of a way to parallelize the computation.

Regarding R libraries, typically you can use existing R libraries inside functions being executed on the executors. 
P.S: Now that SparkR has been merged with mainline Spark, you can send SparkR related questions to us...@spark.apache.org

Thanks
Shivaram
